capabilities: Add a second row to the mobile toolbar
Provide a delete current line command button
Adjust the toolbar's vertical position with a bottom offset slider
intentEvidence: Adds a second row to the Obsidian toolbar on mobile devices, allowing for more quick access buttons.
problem: The mobile toolbar offers only one row of buttons, limiting how many quick-access commands fit on small screens.
summary: Mobile utility that adds a second row of quick-access buttons to the Obsidian mobile toolbar and lets you adjust its vertical offset.
